scripts.dev:llm: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.llm.yml up -d llama
scripts.dev:llm:down: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.llm.yml stop llama
scripts.dev: npm run dev:services && concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.docker:up: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.llm.yml --profile app up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.llm.yml --profile app down
scripts.docker:full: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.llm.yml --profile app --profile full up -d --build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web exec -- npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test
